reasons: target-estimand-replace: The estimand line must expose the maximal graph-indexed equality quotient and the class-specific causal vectors covered by fixed-class inference.
estimand-functional-replace: The functional line must distinguish classwise identification and inference from the one-class common-effect special case.

comparator-promise-table-replace: The comparison record must distinguish fixed-class Wald inference from Chang--Guo--Malinsky post-selection coverage while preserving the established graphical comparator scopes.
The four-node certified input must use the argument order of the corrected certified-input schema, with the optional graph and rational-table certificates placed after the semicolon.

The theorem is synchronized with the already accepted class-indexed estimator and states the fixed-class causal equality, multivariate limit, sandwich consistency, arbitrary fixed-contrast Wald interval, numerical coordinate corollary, and selection scope.

narrow: The existing claim leaves the inferential status of a quotient class implicit and does not exclude reuse of the inference sample for oracle or class selection. The replacement narrows the coverage guarantee to a population-fixed or externally certified true class independent of the inference sample, while applying the same fixed-circuit argument to every returned class and exposing the fixed-contrast Wald consequence required by the directive.

verdict.note: Accepted all three after high math review; global Markov, pairwise reuse, tuple schema, and fixed-class inference are sound.
